expects.query: Build the smallest VSS deployment for NemoClaw to query existing incidents, analytics sensors and occupancy metrics through the VSS CLI. Do not include the in-stack VSS Agent or legacy analytics MCP.
checks: The resolved capability owner for read-only analytics is `video-analytics-api.md`.
The effective service set includes `vss-video-analytics-api` and its Elasticsearch peers.
The analytics skill requirement is satisfied by the available `analytics` CLI command group.
